items.example: We want a green school.
items.exampleZh: 我们想要一所环保的学校。

items.example: Let us make our city greener.
This booklet is about recycling.
items.exampleZh: 这本小册子是关于回收利用的。

items.example: We use both sides of the paper.
We can reuse this bag.
items.exampleZh: 我们可以重复使用这个袋子。

items.example: We should reduce waste.
Reusing things can reduce costs.
items.exampleZh: 重复使用物品可以降低成本。

items.example: We recycle paper and bottles.
items.exampleZh: 我们回收利用纸和瓶子。

items.example: Do not throw stones.
Do not throw away this box.
Please pick up the rubbish.
Turn off the lights when you leave.
Turn on the television, please.
Dirty water can pollute the river.
Air pollution is bad for us.
Walking is a healthy habit.
items.exampleZh: 步行是一个健康的习惯。

items.meaningZh: 适合……的习惯；关于……的习惯
items.example: The booklet shows good habits for a green life.
items.exampleZh: 这本小册子介绍环保生活的好习惯。
acceptedMeaningsZh: 适合……的习惯；关于……的习惯

groups.sourceText: a good way / It’s a good way to (do) ...

items.example: Walking is a good way to stay healthy.
items.exampleZh: 步行是保持健康的好方法。

items.term: It's a good way to do ...
items.example: It's a good way to save water.
items.exampleZh: 这是节约用水的好方法。

groups.sourceText: take ... / take a bus / take a car / take the subway

items.example: I take my bag to school.
I take a bus to school.
We take a car to the park.
They take the subway to work.

groups.sourceText: walk to ... = go to ... on foot

items.example: I walk to school every day.
We go to the library on foot.

groups.sourceText: It’s a good / great way to do ...

items.term: It's a good way to do ...
items.example: It's a good way to save energy.
items.exampleZh: 这是节约能源的好方法。

items.term: It's a great way to do ...
items.example: It's a great way to keep fit.
items.exampleZh: 这是保持健康的好办法。

groups.sourceText: give sth. to sb. / give the meat to the dog / give them to the girls

items.example: Please give the book to Amy.

items.term: give the meat to the dog
items.example: I give the meat to the dog.
Please give them to the girls.
Little kids like these toys.
items.exampleZh: 小孩子们喜欢这些玩具。

groups.sourceText: play with sth. / play with the toys

items.example: Do not play with fire.
The children play with the toys.
This bottle is made of plastic.
Do not use too many plastic bags.
This bag is made of cloth.
Please use less paper.

groups.sourceText: tap / turn on the tap / turn off the tap

items.example: The tap is still on.
Turn on the tap to wash your hands.
Turn off the tap after washing.
I brush my teeth twice a day.
We should save water every day.
items.exampleZh: 我们每天都应该节约用水。

groups.sourceText: side / both sides / both sides of the paper

items.example: Write on this side of the paper.
The paper has words on both sides.
Use both sides of the paper.
I see. We should use less paper.
items.exampleZh: 我明白了。我们应该少用纸。

groups.sourceText: be made of ... / be made from ...

items.example: The chair is made of wood.
items.exampleZh: 这把椅子是木头制成的。

items.example: Paper is made from wood.

groups.sourceText: The desk is made of wood. / Paper is made from wood.

items.term: The desk is made of wood.
items.meaningZh: 这张书桌是木头制成的。
items.example: The desk is made of wood.
items.exampleZh: 这张书桌是木头制成的。
acceptedMeaningsZh: 这张书桌是木头制成的。

items.example: Paper is made from wood.
We need paper for the poster.
There is little paper in the box.
We should use less paper.
We can save energy at home.
items.exampleZh: 我们可以在家节约能源。

groups.sourceText: remind / remind sb. to do sth. / remind sb. of sth. / remind my mum to buy a cake / remind me of my classmates

items.example: This photo can remind me of our trip.
items.exampleZh: 这张照片能让我想起我们的旅行。

items.example: Please remind me to turn off the light.
The song reminds me of my school.

items.term: remind my mum to buy a cake
items.example: I remind my mum to buy a cake.
These photos remind me of my classmates.
items.exampleZh: 这些照片让我想起同学们。

items.example: Unplug the television after use.
Wash your hands after playing outside.
Unplug it after watching TV.
The sun gives us energy.
Turn off the lights to save energy.
Cars can cause air pollution.
Reading every day is a good habit.
items.exampleZh: 每天阅读是一个好习惯。

items.example: Going to bed early is a healthy habit.
items.exampleZh: 早睡是一个健康的习惯。

items.example: We plant seeds in the garden.
We water the flowers and watch them grow.
items.exampleZh: 我们给花浇水，看着它们生长。

groups.sourceText: keep sth. adj. / keep the air clean / keep the air fresh

items.example: Trees keep our city cool.
items.exampleZh: 树木让我们的城市保持凉爽。

items.example: Trees help keep the air clean.
items.exampleZh: 树木帮助保持空气清洁。

items.example: Plants can keep the air fresh.
items.exampleZh: 植物可以保持空气清新。

items.example: Wash your hands before eating.
Turn off the tap after washing.
Do not throw away useful things.
The bottle is useful, so don't throw it away.
items.exampleZh: 这个瓶子有用，所以不要把它扔掉。

items.example: Put the rubbish in the bin.
The rubbish bin is near the door.
We sort rubbish at school.
items.exampleZh: 我们在学校进行垃圾分类。

items.example: Do not drop rubbish on the ground.
Drop the bottle into the right bin.
items.exampleZh: 把瓶子投进正确的垃圾桶。

items.example: A whale lives in the sea.
Please eat up your lunch.
The turtle may eat it up.
A jellyfish swims in the sea.
Dust can make me sneeze.
Open your mouth wide.
The turtle swims slowly.
The tortoise walks on land.
I can spot a whale in the sea.
items.exampleZh: 我能在海里发现一头鲸。

items.example: Do not swallow the plastic bag.
Dirty water can make us ill.
The smoke makes me cough.
He began to cough hard.
Go home at once.
A big wave carried the bottle away.
items.exampleZh: 一个大浪把瓶子冲走了。

items.example: I carry my bag to school.

items.meaningZh: 搬运；携带（第三人称单数）
items.example: The river carries rubbish to the sea.
acceptedMeaningsZh: 搬运；携带（第三人称单数）

groups.sourceText: beach / on the beach / at the beach

items.example: The beach is clean today.
We pick up rubbish on the beach.
We had fun at the beach.
items.exampleZh: 我们在海滩玩得很开心。

items.example: The cat likes to lie in the sun.
Plastic bags lie around on the beach.

groups.sourceText: throw the rubbish away / throw the box away

items.example: Please throw the rubbish away.
Do not throw the box away.
This book is a gift from Mum.
items.exampleZh: 这本书是妈妈送的礼物。

items.example: Children get gifts on their birthdays.
items.exampleZh: 孩子们在生日时收到礼物。

items.example: We collect old paper at school.
Let's collect the boxes for reuse.
items.exampleZh: 让我们收集这些盒子再利用。
